remarks: Located on a quiet cul de sac only one mile from Metro North Train Station/I95 and two miles from Compo Beach, Longshore Country Club and downtown Westport - could your new home be any more convenient? Multiple HOBI award winning builder, CCO Habitats, presents its latest new construction project - a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bath home finished on 4 levels with room for a smaller pool. As always, there are some new features to discover, making this home unique from anything previously built. There's a warm, welcoming vibe, with oversized European tilting windows allowing the natural light to blend seamlessly with the white oak and glass interiors. Cozy modern. Sophisticated and stylish. An open floor plan presents a variety of lifestyle options. You can have either one or two offices and still have four multipurpose rooms to enjoy in different ways. Perhaps a living room, a family room, a media room and a great room? And that's not even including the gym! Maybe you'd prefer a library or a studio - go for it! There's an EV outlet waiting for you and yes, it's generator ready as well. It's just so easy. Functionality meets beauty and combines to create a truly livable home. Come discover. Come enjoy. Come home.
